# University of Waterloo

> Canada's premier engineering and co-operative education institution, offering comprehensive academic programs across six faculties with strong industry partnerships and student support services.

University of Waterloo is located in Ontario, Canada and comprises multiple affiliated colleges (Conrad Grebel, Renison, St. Jerome's, United College) alongside its main academic divisions. The university is renowned for its co-operative education model, connecting students with employers through the WaterlooWorks recruitment system.

## Key Topics

- Faculties: Arts, Engineering, Environment, Health, Mathematics, Science
- Affiliated Colleges: Conrad Grebel, Renison, St. Jerome's, United College
- Co-operative Education
- WaterlooWorks Recruitment System
- Academic Programs
- Student Health and Wellness
- Alumni Engagement
- Fundraising and Giving
- Campus Events
- Institutional Structure
- Employer Partnerships

## Academics and Faculties

- [Faculties and Academics](https://uwaterloo.ca/faculties-academics): Overview of University of Waterloo's faculties including Arts, Engineering, Environment, and Health with comprehensive academic program information.

## Student Life and Support

- [Health and Well-being](https://uwaterloo.ca/students/health-and-well-being): Student health and wellness resources including counseling and campus wellness services.

## Employer and Co-op Resources

- [How to Hire a Co-op Student](https://uwaterloo.ca/hire/how-to-hire): Guide to hiring co-op students via WaterlooWorks recruitment system from 120+ programs.

## Giving and Alumni Engagement

- [Support Waterloo](https://uwaterloo.ca/support): Support Waterloo fundraising and alumni engagement platform for donors and volunteers.

## Events

- [CODA - Senior Undergraduate Fine Arts Exhibition](https://uwaterloo.ca/events/events/coda): 52nd Senior Undergraduate Fine Arts Exhibition at University of Waterloo Art Gallery.
- [CPI 2nd Graduate Student Conference](https://uwaterloo.ca/events/events/cpi-2nd-graduate-student-conference): Cybersecurity and Privacy Institute graduate student conference with networking and research presentations.
- [Computer Museum Open House](https://uwaterloo.ca/events/events/computer-museum-open-house-0): Computer Museum open house event featuring vintage systems and artifact collections.
